dedupe_keys.name: gnu rl differentiable mpc hvac control policy

description: The Gnu-RL repository publishes code for a building HVAC control policy that combines imitation learning with a differentiable model-predictive-control layer and later reinforcement-learning updates. Its README says the agent first learns from historical controller data, then improves through interaction with a building environment. The public tree lists agent code, a demonstration notebook, stored result arrays and model weights. The publisher documents Gym-Eplus, EnergyPlus, model files and weather files as dependencies, including a manual year setting in an older wrapper; the review did not install or run them. The repository carries an MIT licence. Coverage is the documented building HVAC experiment and its supplied model and weather setup, not a survey of buildings. Its reported energy and comfort performance comes from the cited experiment and was not reproduced here. Simulation use includes testing learned HVAC control against a building-energy environment or using the code as a benchmark policy, after supplying compatible building and weather inputs. It complements model-energyplus as a controller layered on a building simulator, not a replacement physical building model. A caveat is that historic software versions and external wrappers may impede direct reproduction on a current installation.
